operators.name: maxpool2d_forward
semantics: Performs 2D max pooling over input tensor as in torch.nn.functional.max_pool2d with given kernel_size, stride, padding, dilation, ceil_mode.
Output shape matches reference MaxPool2d with kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False: [N,C,floor(H/2),floor(W/2)].
For each output element, computes max over input window of size kernel_size x kernel_size at position (i*stride - padding, j*stride - padding) with dilation.
Supports arbitrary input strides; explicit contiguous handling or generalized indexing.
Returns torch.float32 tensor on same device as input.
Calls self.maxpool (nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False)) on input x.
Input x is CUDA float32 tensor of shape [16,3,3072,1536].
Output is CUDA float32 tensor of shape [16,3,1536,768] containing maximum values over each 2x2 non-overlapping window.
No padding or dilation; kernel size equals stride, so windows are non-overlapping and cover input exactly.
